headline: Discussed pilot project to promote native plant landscaping in residential backyards using Legacy Fund grants
summary: The subcommittee discussed a Nature Based Climate Solutions Pilot Project to encourage re-wilding residential backyards and native plant integration, tying in stewardship zones from the Open Space Plan. Members proposed setting aside about $40 (up to) for next year's grant round and developing a concept to review at the August open space meeting.

Open Space Subcommittee Meeting Minutes 
 
 
July 6, 2026 at 4:30 PM 
 
311 North Avenue, Conference Room or Remote via Zoom 
 
 
Present: Scott Gustin, Dan Cahill, Jules Shen, Zoe Richards, Rebecca Roman, Dianne Hannigan, Laura 
Hill, Michelle Lockhart, Clara ___, & Sharon Bushor.  
 
 
I. Public Comment 
Sharon Bushor was present and had comments for the full Conservation Board meeting.     
II. Discussion Items 
- Nature Based Climate Solutions Pilot Project 
 
Dan overviewed the concept and the local interest in re-wilding residential backyards.  Dan noted about 
30% of the Legacy Fund goes to grant funding for NBCS.  The new Open Space Plan identifies 
stewardship zones.  There is opportunity here to create a pilot project to bring the two together and 
promote/facilitate native plant integration into our neighborhoods.   
 
ZR mentioned the stewardship zones.  Dan, alternatively, are there things in place already that we can 
support/enhance rather than pilot a whole new thing?  Michelle noted the Sea Grant’s residential 
stormwater program that contains native planting and fertilizer reduction components.  Laura Hill, 
growing out priority species for seed production, focus of sabbatical this upcoming fall.  We’ve not yet 
looked at the methods to convert lawn to native plantings.  Maybe its something Dianne and company 
could help with.   
 
Dan noted the NBCS grant cycle.  Awarded grants are firmed up sometime in March every year. What 
about multi-year grant programing?  ZR, the Legacy Fund could provide consistency in funding of these 
local efforts.   
 
RR summarized.  Set aside ~ $40 (up to) for next year’s grant round.  Figure out what systems could 
support the project.  Figure out what local organizations can enable and support the implementation.  Dan, 
figure out who’s doing what.  RR, something along the lines of: This is the project we’re going to do, who 
is going to do what?  Dan, we can put together a concept to review and refine at our August open space 
meeting.  Jules would like communications to be part of the ongoing discussions.
III. Adjournment 
 
5:30 PM.
